name: pixel-office
description: A Windows-only live pixel office for Codex subagents, with 729 appearances, eight desks, a pet Boss, a centered company gate, overflow queues, rest areas, and clock-out animations.

interface.shortDescription: 看子智能体在像素办公室里打工
interface.longDescription: A Windows-only live pixel-art office that mirrors Codex subagents in real time: workers receive one of 729 compatible three-part appearances, use eight distinct desks, stream output in cloud bubbles, wait in the lounge or pantry after a terminal result, and clock out after 30 minutes. The center desk has a pet Boss and the bottom entrance is a company gate. Overflow queues keep additional active and delivering workers separated.
